verdict.rationale: Lago documents a webhook system built for reliability: HMAC signatures, automatic retries (3 attempts on non-2xx responses or network errors), and a log view to inspect and retry events. Its versioning policy also implies a growing set of webhook event types. However, the pack never shows that the specific subscription state changes in the story emit events, so coverage of the full lifecycle is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit list of subscription lifecycle webhook events (renewal, upgrade/downgrade, payment failure, cancellation), evidence of delivery guarantees beyond 3 retries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
